d: The Commercial Lawyer provides specialist legal advice and commercial legal support to Mediclinic Middle East, ensuring that commercial arrangements, transactions and business activities are appropriately structured, legally compliant and aligned with organisational objectives.

Reporting to the Legal General Counsel, the role is responsible for drafting, reviewing and negotiating commercial agreements, advising on contractual rights and obligations, identifying and mitigating legal risks, and supporting strategic business initiatives across the organisation.

The Commercial Lawyer works closely with corporate functions, hospital management and relevant operational stakeholders to provide commercially practical legal guidance on procurement, partnerships, service arrangements, healthcare-related transactions and other contractual matters.

The role contributes to protecting MCME’s legal and commercial interests, strengthening contractual governance, supporting informed business decisions and facilitating the timely execution of business activities in accordance with applicable UAE legislation, healthcare regulatory requirements and organisational policies.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Law (LLB) or an equivalent recognised legal qualification.
Master’s degree in Law (LLM), particularly in Corporate Law, Commercial Law or a related discipline.
Additional professional development in contract negotiation, corporate governance, healthcare law, regulatory compliance or legal risk management.

Proven experience drafting, preparing, reviewing, negotiating and managing a broad range and high volume of operational commercial contracts, rather than experience limited to large bespoke transactions.
Experience gained in a reputable law firm and/or in-house legal function, with a strong preference for meaningful in-house exposure.
Demonstrated ability to independently manage a substantial contracts portfolio, prioritise competing requests and deliver practical advice within business timeframes.
Experience negotiating contractual arrangements with suppliers, customers, consultants, service providers and strategic partners.
Commercial litigation and dispute management experience, including pre-litigation strategy, claims assessment, settlement discussions and management of external counsel.
Proven ability to identify, assess and mitigate legal, contractual, financial, operational and reputational risks.
Experience within healthcare, life sciences, pharmaceuticals, medical devices, healthcare technology or another highly regulated sector.
UAE and/or broader GCC legal experience.
Experience supporting technology, SaaS, software licensing, data processing and digital transformation projects.
Experience advising on procurement, outsourcing, facilities management and other operational contracts.
Experience managing external legal counsel, commercial litigation and dispute resolution matters.
Admission to practise law or an equivalent recognised legal professional qualification in an applicable jurisdiction, where required for the position.
External counsel, litigation budget and legal service management
Technology, software licensing and data-related contracting
Healthcare commercial agreements and sector-specific legal considerations
Commercial dispute, litigation and arbitration management
Relevant statutory requirements and legislations (International Financial Reporting Standards / company law / competition law / commercial law)
Ability to collaborate with stakeholders in different operational units and functions
Ability to collaborate effectively with diverse technical, clinical and business stakeholders
r: Commercial Disputes, Litigation and Legal Risk Management
Stakeholder Management, External Counsel and Legal Service Delivery
